synthesizedFacts.fact: Fine lines are subtle, shallow creases that typically appear in your 20s or 30s and are most noticeable when making expressions.
Wrinkles are deeper creases that become more prominent with age and are visible even when the face is relaxed.
Dehydration lines can mimic fine lines but often disappear with proper hydration.
Collagen production slows with age, contributing to the formation of fine lines and wrinkles.
Sun exposure, genetics, and repeated facial movements are significant contributors to wrinkle formation.
